hypothesis: Phone wrong-word false warnings are stable consonant confusions in the shipped weights, which have only ever seen synthetic band-limiting. The one real-narrowband fine-tune cleared 7 of 8 targets but collapsed because it was trained on a single verse. Fine-tuning on a real narrowband corpus that covers many ayahs and reciters, mixed with the original data and anchored to the shipped model, should keep part of that gain without the collapse; predict 4 of 8 won, listener -4, overall -3 after losses.
